contract.busy_lock: REFUSED_NOT_RESERVED, effect_calls=0, no marker; no retry permission; elected J-day slot still consumed by casca before invoking L12
contract.busy_no_marker: REFUSED_NOT_RESERVED, recovery=false; no retry permission or J2/J3 fallback
contract.exact_preexisting_committed_TERMINAL: V2 original recovered=false matching row, or V1 nonUNCERTAIN matching row; REFUSED_CONSUMED, 0 effect, durable=true, recovery=false, previous terminal status/SHA
contract.legacy_V1_UNCERTAIN: Cannot distinguish original commitment from recovery without marker bit; conservatively UNCERTAIN_CONSUMED/recovery=true
contract.pending_or_orphan_or_recovered_terminal_: UNCERTAIN_CONSUMED, effect_calls=0, recovery_required=true; no effect or callback or retry
contract.recovery_required_false: Only ledger history closed; no repair or certainty of previous effect and no operational GO
contract.returned_data: FiniteBatch.run and OuterLimiter.run use one reservation_result builder on ReservationFailure, not platform-dependent exception contract
contract.terminal_proof: V2 persisted recovered boolean; exact original V1 proof compatible read-only
